_comment: Role -> model. Model ab chhota token hai: 'llm' (worker) ya 'thinker' (orchestrator). Asli id ~/agentconfig/agentconfig.env se aata hai (llmctl switch se badalta hai). Is file mein provider/ID kabhi mat likho. Optional per-role 'command' (argv template with {model}/{prompt}) un tools ke liye hai jo subagent spawn nahi kar sakte; DEVTEAM_AGENT_CMD wahi template env se deta hai.
